before:
Summarize this report and make it good, don't make it too long and don't miss important stuff.
{{REPORT}}
after: You are an analyst writing for busy managers.
The managers will read this on their phones before a meeting, so they need the decisions and numbers first.
Return 5 bullets at most, each under 25 words, ordered by importance. End with one line that starts with 'Decision needed:'.

before: Write an email to a customer about the delay. Be nice and professional. Don't blame us.
after: You are a support lead at an online electronics shop.
Order {{ORDER_ID}} will arrive 4 days late because the courier lost a pallet. The customer has been loyal for 3 years, so we want to keep their trust.
Write an email to the customer explaining the delay and offering free shipping on their next order.
Plain text, 3 short paragraphs, under 120 words, signed 'Sara, Customer Care'.

<example>
Tone: warm and direct, for example: 'Your parcel is running late, and we're sorry.'
</example>
Describe the courier problem as the reason, and take responsibility for fixing it.

before: Write python code to check if a password is strong.
after: You are a senior Python developer.
The function will run on a sign-up form, so it must be fast and easy for a junior developer to maintain.
Write a function is_strong(password: str) -> bool.
Rules: at least 12 characters, one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit and one symbol. Return the code in one block, with type hints and a docstring, followed by 5 pytest tests.
Before you finish, verify each test against the rules and make sure the code runs on Python 3.9.

before: Get the info from this invoice. {{INVOICE}}
after: The JSON goes straight into our accounting system, so the keys and types must match exactly.
Extract the invoice fields from the text above.
Return only a JSON object with these keys: invoice_number (string), date (YYYY-MM-DD), supplier (string), total (number), currency (3-letter code). Use null when a field is missing.

<examples>
<example>Input: 'Inv #A-17, 3 Mar 2026, Nour Ltd, total IQD 250,000' Output: {"invoice_number": "A-17", "date": "2026-03-03", "supplier": "Nour Ltd", "total": 250000, "currency": "IQD"}</example>
</examples>
Before answering, check that the total matches the number in the text.
You are a professional English-to-Arabic translator.

Keep the original headings and numbered list. Keep technical terms such as 'oscilloscope' in English in brackets after the Arabic word. Return only the translation.

before: A tank fills in 6 hours and drains in 9. How long to fill? Just give me the answer, don't explain too much.
after: You are a careful math tutor.

Show the work in at most 4 numbered steps, then give the final answer inside <answer></answer> tags in hours.
Before you finish, verify the answer by plugging it back into the rates.

Return one word: positive, negative or mixed.

<examples>
<example>'Fast delivery, works great' -> positive</example>
<example>'Broke after two days' -> negative</example>
<example>'Great screen, but the battery dies by noon' -> mixed</example>
</examples>
